meta.title: Holiday Guide
meta.subtitle: Shop Local For Gifts And More

businesses.name: Stratford Hall Historic Preserve
businesses.blurb: The gift shop carries sweaters, books, kitchenware and stuffed animals with real historic character, plus custom gift baskets of premium jams, nuts, handmade ornaments, Edwards petite country ham and Stratford Hall grits milled on site in the 1738 gristmill.

businesses.name: WPA Bakery
businesses.blurb: Holiday desserts including a pumpkin-caramel swirl cheesecake, with most selections adaptable to gluten-free and vegan diets. Order guides post the first week of November and December — call or email to place an order.

businesses.name: World of Mirth
businesses.blurb: Jellycat's Letter to Santa is a polar explorer on a quest for the Northern Lights, camera and flask of cocoa at the ready. Any message to Santa gets her stamp of approval.

businesses.name: Whitley's Peanut Factory
businesses.blurb: Nearly 40 years of handcrafted snacks and treats, serving Richmond since 2017. Small-batch Virginia peanuts, confections and mixes, with custom assortments for gifting or stocking up for gatherings.

businesses.name: Mary Angela's Pizzeria
businesses.blurb: Thirty-nine years in the heart of Carytown: New York style and Sicilian pizzas, pasta and subs, with a gluten-free crust and vegetarian options. Gift cards available, and catering for holiday luncheons and corporate events.

businesses.name: Meadowgate Alpacas
businesses.blurb: A family-run alpaca farm with exceptionally friendly animals, offering on-site farm visits and appearances at weddings, college campuses and corporate events. Fiber harvested annually becomes clothing and housewares.

businesses.name: AAA Discount Floors & Services, Inc.
businesses.blurb: “Richmond's Best Kept Secret” — family-owned and operated for over 45 years, with thousands of flooring options in stock across a 12,000-square-foot showroom and thousands more available by special order.

businesses.name: 53rd Winery
businesses.blurb: Award-winning wines and peaceful country charm a short drive from Richmond. Check the website for weekend events, special tastings and new releases.

businesses.name: Covington Travel
businesses.blurb: Fifty-eight years of global travel expertise, crafting personalized itineraries from business trips to dream vacations. Insider knowledge and global connections handle the details so you can focus on the adventure.

businesses.name: The Byrd Theatre
businesses.blurb: Richmond's grand movie palace, showing films since 1928 — cult classics, family favorites and classic cinema on the silver screen. Owned and operated by the Byrd Theatre Foundation, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit.

businesses.name: FORT
businesses.blurb: Open-ended, sensory-rich loose play parts that inspire imagination, from in-house collections to a curation of more than 150 brands from around the world.
